name: Kiro changelog
title: General: Local Sandbox Controls in Enterprise Management
headline: Kiro lets admins enforce local sandboxing
lede: Enterprise admins can require local sandboxing for commands and local stdio MCP servers in Kiro IDE and Kiro CLI, with organization-set file and network defaults.

effects.effect: Local coding tools can inherit enterprise sandbox settings.
Local MCP servers can fall under required sandboxing.
